claim: You can deploy Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts as extended clusters, which run the Kubernetes control plane in an AWS Region and nodes on your Outpost, or as local clusters, which run the Kubernetes control plane and nodes on your Outpost; for both deployment options, the Kubernetes control plane is fully managed by AWS.

evidence.quote: You can deploy Amazon EKS on Outposts in the following ways:
Extended clusters** – Run the Kubernetes control plane in an AWS Region and nodes on your Outpost.
Local clusters** – Run the Kubernetes control plane and nodes on your Outpost.
For both deployment options, the Kubernetes control plane is fully managed by AWS.
